layerComplianceSummary.notes: Entities, value objects, aggregates, and repository ABCs have zero external dependencies. All invariants enforced in constructors and state-transition methods.
Use cases depend only on domain ABCs and FileStoragePort. No Django or ORM imports. All DTOs are frozen dataclasses.

Concrete repositories implement domain ABCs. Serializers are DRF ModelSerializers. Permissions enforce object-level org isolation. GCSFileStorageAdapter implements FileStoragePort via default_storage.

DRF viewsets delegate business operations to use cases via infrastructure. React portal pages fetch via REST API with token auth stored in localStorage. ProtectedRoute enforces auth guard client-side.

knownIssues.description: ActivityEvent.actor FK is non-nullable in the ORM model. System-initiated events (e.g. RegisterClientOrganization) that pass actor_id=None will raise an IntegrityError. Mitigation: make actor nullable or require a system user for automated events.

MySQL conditional unique constraint warnings (W036) on allauth EmailAddress model are benign in local SQLite development. Production MySQL deployment is unaffected functionally but the unique constraint is silently dropped.

implementationSummary: Implemented FSP-3 Secure Client Portal across all Clean Architecture layers. Backend: installed djangorestframework, django-allauth, dj-rest-auth; added 12 DRF viewsets with per-org queryset filtering and object-level permissions; 20 use case classes with repository injection; GCS file storage adapter; Django-Q2 background task for approval notifications; comprehensive seed script. Frontend: email/password login page with token storage, PortalDashboardPage, PortalProjectDetailPage (milestones + approval actions), PortalFilesPage (XHR upload with progress), PortalMessagesPage (thread/message list + compose), ProtectedRoute guard. All 54 unit tests pass, Django system check clean, frontend builds successfully.
